item.title: 英伟达 Switchyard 路由器可在任务中途重新调度 AI 模型，自测中将任务成本降至三分之一
item.summary: Enterprises running always-on AI agents keep hitting the same tradeoff. Send every task to a frontier model and the bill climbs fast.
